official_primary.finding: Gen can be embedded in RNBO and exported.
Gen audio kernels run per sample; history is a one-sample delay; non-audio Gen/Jitter domains are distinct.
GenExpr is the Gen codebox language, distinct from RNBO codebox.

scope: Gen/common/DSP patcher names, RNBO GenExpr translation registry and Jitter are distinct surfaces.
All named entries remain pending actual native and device execution; aliases never inherit results.
Both refpages and refpages1 are included; Gen package has no separate discovered version, so metadata is pinned to Max9.1.4.
GenExpr syntax/constructors/constants/globals are separate from RNBO codebox and are not an exhaustive language grammar claim.
Official Max Gen documentation describes binary64 patcher values; RNBO Float32 SDK profile is a separate numerical contract.

The 216-name common/DSP/reference/translator union does not include every GenExpr declaration, constant, global or grammar form. These are inventoried separately; Jitter has its own 30 reference pages.

Metadata is an inventory of names from the pinned local sources and primary documentation, not a support promise for every saved patch representation, resource path, operator, alias, non-audio Gen or Jitter.
